title: Permanent liquidity zones with 3-state lifecycle + chart styling

requirements.summary: Keep all untouched liquidity boxes permanently visible until first price interaction; never remove due to time/distance alone.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a computed liquidity box that has no recorded touch since its creation, it remains present in the returned LiquidityModel.boxes for all subsequent candles until the first touch occurs.
No rule removes a box solely because many candles have passed or because price moved far away without first touching the box.
The updated behavior applies symmetrically to both upper (isUpper=true) and lower (isUpper=false) boxes.

file_operations.description: Update post-processing lifecycle management so boxes with zero interactions since creation are never removed for time/distance reasons; ensure touch tracking is computed deterministically from candle interactions and applied symmetrically for upper/lower boxes while preserving the existing box creation/detection logic (Step 1–2).

Adjust liquidity box typing to support explicit lifecycle/state output (e.g., distinguish untouched vs active) while maintaining existing wick-based minPrice/maxPrice coordinates and direction flag (isUpper).

requirements.summary: Classify and mark an 'Active Liquidity Zone' when price is trading inside a box or has 1–3 recent candles forming inside it; keep it visible and visually distinct.
acceptanceCriteria: A liquidity box is classified as Active when the current/latest candle is inside the box, or when the most recent interactions include 1–3 candles inside the box as defined by the updated interaction logic.
Active classification is recomputed whenever the candle series changes (e.g., new monthly candle arrives), and the UI updates immediately to reflect changes.
An untouched box (never touched) is not rendered with the Active styling unless price is currently inside it (i.e., it becomes Active when entered).

file_operations.description: Implement Active Market Box classification during lifecycle evaluation: compute whether the latest candle is inside a box and/or whether the most recent 1–3 candles include an in-box sequence; output the active state per box without introducing any time-based expiry.

Update box rendering to use the new Active classification for styling and to ensure the active/untouched visual change happens immediately on candle-series updates (based on the updated liquidity model output).

requirements.summary: Remove liquidity boxes after they are touched and then clearly displaced away with no ongoing interaction; do not render any faded history state.
acceptanceCriteria: Once a box is determined to be 'touched and cleared' under the updated rules, it is excluded from LiquidityModel.boxes and therefore no longer rendered.
No separate 'inactive but visible' (faded) state remains for invalidated liquidity; invalidated zones disappear entirely.
The same touch-and-clear removal logic applies to both upper and lower liquidity boxes (no directional bias).

file_operations.description: Replace existing invalidation rules with a touch-and-clear rule: once a box has at least one touch, evaluate for clear displacement away and lack of interaction; if satisfied, exclude it from the returned boxes (no 'inactive but visible' state). Ensure logic is symmetric for upper/lower boxes and does not remove untouched boxes.
Remove any UI assumptions for a third 'inactive/faded' rendered state so invalidated boxes are simply not present (and therefore not drawn).

requirements.summary: Render liquidity boxes in 3 states: Untouched (neutral), Active (highlight), Invalidated (not rendered); update the legend accordingly in English.
acceptanceCriteria: Untouched boxes render with a neutral fill and thin border that is visually distinct from Active boxes.
Active boxes render with a highlight fill and stronger border and are clearly distinguishable from Untouched boxes.

The legend labels and swatches reflect the new states: 'Untouched Liquidity Zone' and 'Active Liquidity Zone'; no 'Inactive Zone' legend item remains if invalidated zones are removed rather than faded.
All user-facing labels are in English.

file_operations.description: Update ReferenceArea styling rules to support exactly two rendered styles (Untouched vs Active) and ensure invalidated zones are not rendered at all; update legend items to 'Untouched Liquidity Zone' and 'Active Liquidity Zone' and remove the 'Inactive Zone' legend entry (keep all labels in English).
Add/adjust global theme tokens (CSS variables) for liquidity zone fills/borders (neutral vs highlight) so chart styling is consistent and easy to tune without changing rendering logic.

requirements.summary: Make lifecycle evaluation deterministic and performant on each new monthly candle; instantly update enter/exit colors; prevent duplicate/overlapping boxes while preserving base detection logic and wick-based coordinates.
acceptanceCriteria: The reversal/box creation logic remains functionally the same as before; only lifecycle/state classification and rendering behavior changes.

When the candles array changes (React Query refresh/new candle), liquidity boxes are recomputed and their state (Untouched vs Active vs Removed) is updated accordingly without requiring a manual refresh.
The model does not return multiple overlapping/duplicate boxes for the same logical zone (same direction and materially identical min/max bounds) after lifecycle processing.
All boxes use the wick-derived minPrice/maxPrice coordinates produced by the existing algorithm, without introducing non-wick-based coordinates.

file_operations.description: Ensure lifecycle/state evaluation is purely derived from the current candles array (deterministic), computed in a single pass where possible (performance), and add a post-processing deduplication/merge step to avoid duplicate/overlapping boxes for the same direction and materially identical wick bounds—without altering the existing box creation logic or non-wick coordinates.
Confirm memoization dependencies correctly re-trigger model recomputation on monthly candle updates and that the hook returns the updated state immediately for chart re-rendering (no manual refresh).
